collection.title: Ford Transit 1986 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Transit 1986 - 2000 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
